posts.title: Syncing beatgrids
posts.description: I’ve put up a beta release of Seabass which allows synching beatgrids and waveforms from Rekordbox to Denon’s Engine OS database on your USB stick. posts.title: Announcing Seabass 1.0: Your DJ Toolbox
posts.description: I’ve been DJing a lot lately, and as it happens, I like Denon DJ hardware.
